snippet: Hi team, attached is our seed deck. We are raising USD 3M on a post-money SAFE.
body:
Hi team,

Attached is the Acme Robotics seed deck. We build mobile picking arms for mid-size warehouses and reached USD 1.2M ARR in October, growing 15% month over month.

We are raising USD 3M on a post-money SAFE at a USD 15M cap. Happy to walk you through it this week.

Best,
Maya Chen
CEO, Acme Robotics
